games.name: Grow A Brick
games.desc:
Welcome to Grow A Brick!

This game is meant to be a super-optimized rewrite of the original game.

Update 1.1.1.0_02:
◼ New help GUI.
◼ Squashed a few bugs. Probably added new ones.

Update 1.1.1.0_01:
◼ New GUI when players join.
◼ No other functional changes.

Update 1.1.1.0:
◼ Changed how brick mass is displayed in the leaderboard.
◼ Teleporting finally cancels your momentum. My bad!

Update 1.1.0.9:
◼ Fixed bricks catastrophically deleting themselves when attempting to attack.
◼ Food should now immediately disappear when picked up. 

As always, have fun!

Credits to Uberubert for the original Grow A Brick.

games.name: [FREE AVA  X 4000] MOUNT ARGAPURA
games.desc:
⛰️ Mount Argapura 🌄
✨ Ready to Conquer the Natural Beauty of East Java? ✨ 

🔹 About the Game 
The legendary mountain in East Java - Mount Argapura! Enjoy an exciting adventure through various challenging terrains and stunning natural landscapes.

[BETA] Still in development stage 

🔹 Explorable Areas 
🌿 Wet Forest - lush and cool. 
❄️ The summit of the statue - shrouded in fog and cold. 
🔥 Valley of Heat - an extreme area that tests your resilience. 
🏜️ The Savanna - vast and breathtaking. 
💀 Toxic Zone - mysterious and full of surprises. 

🔹 Main Features 
🪧 22 Checkpoint - save your progress on every journey. 
🧍 Carrying System - help your friend on the climbing trail. 
📸 Cool Photo Spots - capture your best moments. 
🧑‍🤝‍🧑 Play Together with Friends - cooperate and reach the summit together! 

🔹 End of the Journey 
🌄 Overcome all obstacles, reach the summit of ARGAPURA, and prove that you are a true climber of Mount Argapura!
